rationale.reason: Solid-manure and granular-fertilizer implements fit 8432.41/.42; liquid sprayers and carriers are excluded.

reviewed_boundary.scope:
1. Scope and Applicability

This rule covers manufacture of complete tractor-mounted or trailed implements for spreading solid or semi-solid manure or distributing granular mineral fertilizer. Distinguish apron/auger/beater manure spreaders from disc or metering fertilizer distributors by configured model. It excludes liquid spraying equipment, slurry transport tankers and injectors, self-propelled carrier vehicles, tractors, standalone fertilizer manufacture, separately sold replacement parts, farm application, crop yield, maintenance and end of life. This intentionally bounded machinery category needs configuration-aware materials, conditional finishing and count-to-net-mass normalization; neighbouring soil-preparation and baler methods do not describe its dosing and corrosive-contact configuration.
reviewed_boundary.covered: Complete mounted and trailed solid/semi-solid manure spreaders and granular fertilizer distributors
reviewed_boundary.excluded: Liquid applicators; carriers and tractors; separately sold parts; nutrient products and agricultural services
reviewed_boundary.market_state: New, empty, accepted complete implement at factory gate; packaging separately inventoried

authored_review_metadata.semantic_boundary_decision: New bounded category for mounted/trailed solid or semi-solid manure and granular fertilizer implements; excludes liquid applicators and carrier vehicles. No overlapping material PCR was found in material index; legacy leaf remains untouched. Classification reference is context, not mapping acceptance. The old leaf ID is a terminal classification-coverage alias under ADR 0003; it is neither promoted nor followed. CPC44114 has no accepted positive edge in the current mapping.
